_comment: Qwen-Image 4-step, using the PRE-MERGED Lightning checkpoint rather than applying the LoRA at runtime. Both Apache-2.0. The merge is not a convenience: applying the bf16 LoRA to the fp8 base makes ComfyUI dequantize the affected layers to patch them, and that spike OOMs a 16GB card every time. A pre-merged checkpoint has nothing to patch. cfg MUST stay 1.0 - a distilled model has no classifier-free guidance to steer, so the negative prompt does nothing here; put everything in the positive. 1104x1472 is Qwen's 3:4, which keeps a standing figure head-to-toe; a square crops at mid-thigh and a cropped concept makes a cropped mesh.

inputs.text: a weathered stone golem overgrown with moss, a single creature standing upright, full body from head to feet, three-quarter view, even flat studio lighting, plain neutral grey background, no cast shadow, game asset concept art, sharp detail
multiple figures, turnaround sheet, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, text, watermark, harsh cast shadows, depth of field, motion blur
